value.signature: fn proposal_message (proposal : & ProposalCommitment) -> Result < ProposalMessage , EncodingError >

review.body: { if proposal . recipe != pn_act_profile :: PROPOSAL_RECIPE { return Err (EncodingError :: Recipe) ; } Ok (ProposalMessage (proposal . bytes)) }
review.item_premise: Complete public arguments and results are recorded, including retained bytes. This operation establishes representation or comparison only, never signature validity, secret possession or chain authority.
